acceptanceCriteria: Profile the rebind dogfood-record and name its dominant cost
The rebind record on the 72-hunk fixture takes under half its #1451 time at comparable load, measured with the timings TSV
No change to the recorded CEM bytes
body: Measured by lane dogfood-perf-1021g (PR #1451, V1-1664) on a 72-hunk docs-only fixture: after the V1-1664 change finish takes 67.5 s at load ~19, of which the rebind dogfood-record step is 14.3 s; at higher load it reached 52 s. Per-command times are in <git-dir>/corvint/dogfood-finish-lane.timings.tsv. Expected: rebind record reuses the prepare pass's index/record work for an unchanged tree. Version: origin/main 8def072 + #1451.

completion.reason: Delivered by lane PR #1472, merged in batch PR beamfall/corvint#1473 (merge commit 9ae946a5c2b03f69a327c9230c30d9f35d1f19dd); PR CI go-product green: https://github.com/beamfall/corvint/actions/runs/39691034588. Owner policy: CI-green merged work needs no local gate.

title: dogfood-finish rebind: dogfood-record costs 14-52 s per run and is now the dominant finish stage
